core_obligations: By the declared input, K = Rf_*F is a perfect object of the derived category of S whose formation commutes with arbitrary base change.
Identify the Euler characteristic chi(X_s, F_s) with the alternating sum sum (-1)^i dim H^i(K tensor^L kappa(s)) using the base-change compatibility.
Apply the declared locally-constant lemma to the displayed function; conclude chi is locally constant on S and its formation commutes with base change.
proof_roadmap: Perfect pushforward with base change; fibre Euler-characteristic identification; locally-constant finish.
difficulty_reason: A two-input reduction: the substance is the identification of the fibre Euler characteristic with the base-changed alternating sum.
